name: Data science pack
summary: Analysis, statistics or machine learning in Python: cleaning data, building and evaluating models, and reporting results.
fitsWhen: a question answered from data (analysis, dashboard, report)
training and evaluating a machine learning model

analysis.summary: Data cleaning, analysis, models and a written result, reproducible from a clean run.

product-manager.changes: Turns the owner's question into a measurable goal and success metric before any data work.

data-analyst.plan: Profiles the raw data (columns, types, missing values, ranges) and writes the cleaning plan. Summaries only, never whole tables.

solution-architect.changes: Decides the Python environment, data storage, pipeline layout and experiment tracking.

statistician.plan: Independently reviews the method: assumptions, sample size, leakage, train and test splits, metrics and how results are stated.

security-compliance-reviewer.changes: Adds personal data, dataset licences and what may be committed.

code-implementer.changes: Code lives in modules, notebooks stay thin and are saved without outputs, random seeds are fixed, raw data is never committed.

test-validator.changes: Re-runs the pipeline from raw data and checks the results match within a stated tolerance.

docs-writer.changes: Writes a data card and, for models, a model card.

it-analyst.changes: Sets up Python, the virtual environment and any database drivers.

skillsToBuild.data-cleaning-standards: How to profile, clean and document data changes; every cleaning step is code, not hand edits.
skillsToBuild.statistics-review-checklist: Assumptions, effect sizes, multiple comparisons, confidence intervals, plain-language claims.
skillsToBuild.ml-evaluation-checklist: Leakage, splits, baselines, metrics that match the goal, overfitting signs.
skillsToBuild.data-science-full-pipeline: Question, data profile, cleaning plan, method review, build, independent method review, reproducibility run, write-up.
